about: Gregg E. Hutt is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026. He works at Trenam Law, located in Tampa, Florida, and provides legal services for issues involving Construction Litigation: Business, Government Contracts and General Litigation to the surrounding community.
Gregg Hutt completed legal studies at University of Florida Levin College of Law and graduated with the class of 2004. Gregg Hutt passed the bar in 2005.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
